messages:
olivia: Heads up — after the KMS rekey earlier today we started seeing duplicate RBAC roles for several tenants and SCIM deprovisioning lagged. Not sure if SCIM, SAML assertion handling, or KMS decrypt fallout. Examples below.

olivia: repro timeline: 09:12 rekey completed, 09:14 prod deploy, 09:18 alert (scim-queue-depth), 09:21 user report of stale access.

olivia: scim-provisioner log snippet:
2026-03-23T09:20:11Z scim-provisioner INFO tenant=acme op=deprovision user=alice status=queued
2026-03-23T09:20:12Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=acme op=decrypt-kms err=AccessDenied
2026-03-23T09:20:12Z scim-provisioner WARN tenant=acme op=apply-role role=eng-beta duplicated=true
2026-03-23T09:20:15Z scim-provisioner INFO tenant=acme op=retry next=09:22:15

olivia: SAML assertion excerpt (masked): <saml:Attribute Name="roles">eng-beta;eng-beta</saml:Attribute>

raj: did we change attribute mapping or claim splitting in the recent deploy? :thinking:  

marta: @olivia can you paste the audit entries for the RBAC schema change and the KMS rekey? looking for ordering.

olivia: audit snippets: 2026-03-23T09:12:00Z audit SERVICE=kms action=rekey user=infra-batch id=kms-rekey-2026-03-23; 2026-03-23T09:15:02Z audit SERVICE=rbac action=update user=platform-admin change=role-schema-v2

olivia: also saw transient 403s from KMS SDK in one AZ for ~30s. devops reported key rotation finished but a permissions hiccup occurred.

security-oncall: potential vuln: if decrypt fails and we retry applyRole without idempotency, stale/duplicated role assignments can persist. Need post-incident audit + reconciler fix.

raj: quick triage checklist: 1) are SCIM ops idempotent by externalId? 2) does provisioner dedupe role applies? 3) do we normalize assertions consistently?

marta: answers: 1) SCIM is idempotent by externalId, but applyRole RPC is separate and relied on kafka replay protection. 2) dedupe is best-effort in-memory, not DB-enforced. 3) assertion normalizer was updated in the same deploy as role-schema-v2. timing bad.

olivia: plausible chain: KMS AccessDenied -> retry triggers duplicate applyRole -> normalizer change results in slightly different role tokenization -> DB stores duplicate role rows -> reconcilers don't de-dupe on deprovision -> users retain access.

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T09:14 by infra-cd succeeded (sha:abc123), rollback window open until 09:44.

marta: mitigation plan: 1) pause replays and retries for affected tenants, 2) DB dedupe script to collapse duplicate (tenant,user,role) triples, 3) patch applyRole to use upsert + add unique constraint, 4) improve KMS error handling to surface AccessDenied fast. Who owns DB script?

raj: I will own DB script. will run dry-run and post results, and spin up temporary reconciliation job to prune duplicates for 2h.

security-oncall: opening a P2 incident. checklist: export audit, tenant notification plan for exposure, and timeline reconstruction.

olivia: raj ping me when dry-run finishes. marta prioritize unique constraint patch and add CI test for KMS AccessDenied behavior.

marta: also will grep assertion-service logs for 'Unexpected Attribute format' and check for JWE header/alg rename that could cause normalizer mismatch.

raj: dry-run: ~42 duplicate rows across 7 tenants. prepping migration and proposing 1-min maintenance window to run cleanup safe-mode.

olivia: thanks — keep this thread for operational updates only. will compile incident summary and timeline when we have final data. :white_check_mark:
